children: US President Donald Trump posted on Saturday he approved new fuel economy standards that terminate the Biden administration's EV mandate.
"These new Standards will take the waste out of building cars in America. That means LOWER PRICES, saving families thousands on a new, beautiful, and safe car," Trump wrote in a Truth Social post.
